message.content:
A vertical rectangular magazine cover features a textured blue background with a red border on the left side. The word "TEMPO" is printed in large white serif font at the top. Above it, smaller text reads "PENGAKUAN BEKAS PERANTARA JUDI BOLA" and "POLEMIK LUKISAN PALSU HENDRA GUNAWAN". Below "TEMPO" is the date "27 JULI-2 AGUSTUS 2015".

The central graphic is a large stylized white eye shape with a dark circular pupil containing a smaller white dot. The eye appears to be crying, with blue liquid dripping from its inner corner. The path of the liquid forms the thin blue outline of a geographical map. Below this graphic, the text "AMUK DALAM SEKAM" and "DI TOLIKARA" appears in large, white, sans-serif capital letters.

In the bottom left corner, there is a white barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00022". To its right, text indicates the price "RP 39.500", the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273".
